entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is VF88602.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Pulling up VF88602 now... I see an order for a VeloFit Performance Jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?
Look, it's the wrong size. It's way too tight. I just need to know if I can return it or not.

Understood. One moment while I check the delivery date. Okay, I see it was delivered 48 days ago. Our policy for a standard item like this jersey is 90 days, so you're definitely within the window for a return.
Great. So what's the next step? I want to do an exchange for a larger size if possible.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the process and sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Once we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the next size up for you. That will be processed automatically as an exchange.
Okay, I see the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
